rows.question: I'm a 2nd-year bachelor's student at PNU and I don't have TOPIK level 3 yet. How many hours per week am I allowed to work part-time?
rows.answer: As a 2nd-year bachelor's student without TOPIK level 3, you are allowed to work up to 10 hours per week part-time. If you meet the language requirement (TOPIK Level 3, KIIP Level 3+, or Sejong Institute Intermediate 1+), you could work up to 25 hours on weekdays and unlimited hours on weekends and semester breaks.

rows.question: I'm a 3rd-year bachelor's student with TOPIK level 4. How many hours can I work on weekdays, and what about during semester breaks?
rows.answer:
As a 3rd-year bachelor's student with TOPIK level 4, you can work up to 25 hours per week on weekdays. During semester breaks, you have no hour limit!

Remember, you still need to obtain an actual work permit. Let me know if you have any other questions about working in Korea or life at PNU!
